name: zhihu/web/pin-detail
description: Retrieves the full content and details of a single Zhihu pin using its unique pin identifier. Returns parsed text blocks, links, and formatting metadata.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme:
# Zhihu Pin Detail API Returns the full record of one Zhihu pin: its text and image blocks, author profile, engagement counts and a sample of users who liked it. It needs one input, the `pin_id` of the pin. ## Use cases - Archive the text and image links of a Zhihu pin before it is edited or deleted. - Track likes, favorites and comments on a pin to compare how a post performs. - Pull the author profile attached to a pin to see who posted it and how many followers they have. - Extract the image URLs and sizes from a pin to build a gallery or run image analysis. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/web/pin-detail" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"pin_id": "2050290260991534603"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `pin_id` | string | Yes | Pin ID | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "ab_config": { "md_interact_unify": "1" }, "admin_closed_comment": false, "author": { "avatar_url": "https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-84d915f37f2c56232c42566f0bef233d_720w.jpg?source=8a6f5…", "badge_v2": { "detail_badges": [], "icon": "", "merged_badges": [], "night_icon": "", "title": "我与我周旋久，宁作我~" }, "exposed_medal": { "avatar_url": "https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-7565d834d652a9960da0cedd8d7952ee_720w.jpg?source=8a6f5…", "description": "被 100 个人关注", "medal_avatar_frame": "", "medal_id": "972477022068568064", "medal_name": "备受瞩目", "mini_avatar_url": "https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-7565d834d652a9960da0cedd8d7952ee_720w.jpg?source=8a6f5…" }, "follower_count": 143, "gender": 0, "headline": "我与我周旋久，宁作我~", "id": "c72367b43730a490687966ceb87e9305", "is_advertiser": false, "is_blocked": false, "is_blocking": false, "is_followed": false, "is_following": false }, "can_top": false, "comment_count": 13, "comment_permission": "all", "comments": [], "content": [ { "content": "普通人学AI，建议死磕这10个油管博主 |

Each block has a `type` such as `text` or `image`. | | `content[].own_text` | Text of a `text` block. It can contain inline HTML tags such as `

`. | | `content[].url / content[].original_url / content[].watermark_url` | Links to an `image` block in its standard, original and watermarked versions. `width` and `height` give the image size. | | `content_html` | The pin body as one HTML string. | | `created` | Creation time of the pin as a Unix timestamp in seconds. | | `like_count / comment_count / favorite_count / repin_count` | Counts of likes, comments, favorites and reposts for the pin. | | `author.name / author.url_token / author.headline / author.follower_count` | Display name, URL token, headline and follower count of the pin author. | | `likers[]` | Sample of users who liked the pin. Each entry has the same profile fields as `author`. | | `reaction.statistics.up_vote_count` | Number of upvotes on the pin. Other counters such as `share_count` and `down_vote_count` sit in the same object. | | `pin_type / state / is_deleted` | Type of the pin, its current state, and whether it is deleted. | ## Notes - `pin_id` is a numeric string such as `2050290260991534603`. The same value comes back in the `id` field. - To read the discussion under a pin, call [Zhihu Pin Comments](/apis/zhihu/web/pin-comments). The `comments` list in this response was empty. - To list pins from one author, call [Zhihu User Pins](/apis/zhihu/web/user-pins), then pass a returned pin ID here. ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Zhihu AI Search Stream](/apis/zhihu/web/ai-search-stream): Returns streaming AI search results from Zhihu based on a query prompt. - [Zhihu Answer Details](/apis/zhihu/web/answer-detail): Retrieves detailed information for a specific Zhihu answer using its numeric ID, including answer text, timestamps, and share links. - [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3): Search Zhihu articles and answers by keyword and get titles, excerpts, authors, vote and comment counts, with sorting, content type and time filters plus offse…
